description: Test columns that allow a retake (herkansing) and their scored attempts (first try + herkansing 1/2 with dates), plus results marked niet gemaakt (missed). Sourced from the same geldend result endpoints as grades_latest. Does not include retake registration (aanmelden) or scheduled make-up dates (inhaalmomenten): those are not exposed on the parent portal API. limit defaults to 200 (max 1000).

leerlingId.description: Numeric leerling id. Required when more than one child is linked.

limit.description: Newest results to scan for retakes. Default 200, max 1000.

name: retakes
title: Retakes (herkansingen)
